name: ink
description: Ink is a functional and minimalistic webapp to write documents in markdown and export them
author: Federico Viscioletti

scripts.build:test: esbuild src/tags.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/test/tags.js && esbuild src/test-support/storage-fixture.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/test/storage.js && esbuild src/app/fs-api.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/test/fs-api.js
scripts.test:cypress: start-server-and-test "npm run serve:test" http://127.0.0.1:4173/ink-app.html "unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; cypress run"
scripts.test: npm run test:qunit && npm run test:cypress
